capabilities: Connect and disconnect Trello cards to notes, including creating new cards
View and update card labels, comments, and checklists from Obsidian
Move connected cards between Trello lists
Browse all open cards assigned to you, grouped by board or sorted by due date
Link multiple cards to one note and customize which card UI elements show
extras: Multiple cards per note is an experimental feature. The README warns that Trello's REST API has strict rate limits, data is cached for one to ten minutes, and the API token should be treated as a password and revoked if exposed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to link notes to Trello cards or interact with card data without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Connect your Trello cards with your Obsidian notes to see and update labels, comments, and checklists

summary: Trello integration that connects Trello cards to notes so labels, comments, and checklists can be viewed and updated inside Obsidian.
